seo_home_description: Julio Rahman is an Android & iOS Developer based in Bandung, building Kotlin and Swift mobile apps for commerce, community, and enterprise products.
seo_projects_description: Explore Android, iOS, Kotlin, and Swift projects by Julio Rahman, including commerce, parenting, fintech, recipe, and community product work.
seo_about_description: About Julio Rahman, a Mobile Developer based in Bandung with experience building Android and iOS products with Kotlin and Swift.
projects_top_title_desc: Join me on a journey through my projects from 2020 to 2024. Discover a variety of work, including projects for clients, personal explorations, and contributions to open-source projects. This is more than just a collection of code. It shows my passion for creating innovative and useful apps.
project_paninti_desc: Paninti is an online shopping platform offering a variety of products for mothers, children, and lifestyle needs. As my third major project at Paninti, I joined the team to refactor and develop new features for this long-running app, which had been managed by multiple developers since 2020.
project_paninti_details:
Key Contributions:

  • Implemented redesign and extensive refactoring
  • Developed new features: presale, affiliates, and fulfillment
  • Upgraded to modern tech stack
  • Utilized Airbnb/Epoxy library for efficient UI rendering
  • Implemented Kotlin Coroutines for improved asynchronous programming

This project provided valuable experience in addressing real-life development challenges and modernizing a complex, established application.
project_parenting_hub_desc: Parenting Hub is a social media and community platform for parents to share articles and experiences about parenting. This was my first project upon joining Paninti. I inherited an existing, unreleased app plagued with bugs and frequent force closes. After careful consideration, our team decided to completely rewrite the Android application.
project_parenting_hub_details:
Key Contributions:

  • Participated in the complete rewrite of the Android application
  • Reimplemented all features from scratch
  • Focused on stability and performance optimization
  • Achieved zero force closes, significantly improving user experience
  • Prepared the app for successful release on the Play Store

This project showcased my ability to tackle complex, existing codebases, make critical decisions for project improvement, and deliver a stable, user-friendly application from a problematic starting point.
project_kocequ_desc: Kocequ is a digital transaction app for cooperative members and MSME communities. As an Android Developer at Praweda Ciptakarsa Informatika (Soedarpo Informatika) from January to August 2022, I developed the existing production app, implementing a homepage redesign, a merchant product catalog, and new registration flows. All these features were released before my time at the company ended.
project_kocequ_details:
January–August 2022 · Key contributions:

  • Maintained an existing Java codebase and wrote new features in Kotlin while retaining the MVP architecture.
  • Contributed registration support APIs using Java Spring Boot.
  • Implemented a merchant catalog for displaying products, without checkout.
  • Resolved UI bugs and crashes, including compatibility issues on Android KitKat.
  • Collaborated with a backend developer and the testing team; UI/UX design and Play Store publishing were handled by others.
xp_top_title_desc: Explore the various experiences that have helped shape my career path. From working at companies to being part of community organizations, I've gained valuable skills and knowledge. Here are some highlights of my professional journey so far.
xp_paninti_desc: At Paninti, I build and maintain Android and iOS products across Parenting Hub and the Paninti App. My Android work uses Kotlin with MVVM and Clean Architecture, integrating REST APIs and Firebase while using Room, Hilt, and Coroutines/Flow; I also own the Play Store release process end to end, helping the Paninti App reach a 4.8 rating and 1K+ downloads, and contribute to production iOS apps with Swift and UIKit.
xp_samudera_desc: At Samudera Indonesia, I worked as a Software Developer focused on Android for a fintech app with marketplace capabilities. I built features with Kotlin and Java using MVP architecture, integrated REST APIs with Retrofit, and contributed to Spring Boot backend services by developing 5+ REST API endpoints in a multiservice environment.
xp_79_desc: 79 operates as an agency that hires individuals and outsources them to suitable client companies after providing training. In my case, I went through their 3-month bootcamp for 2 weeks before being placed at Praweda (Samudera Indonesia). Even after the outsourcing, 79 continued to provide monthly mentorship alongside my work experience there.
xp_gits_desc: My 6-month PKL (internship) at GITS Indonesia was my first professional experience after studying software engineering at SMK (vocational high school). It exposed me to cutting-edge technologies and a vibrant work culture vastly different from school, easing my transition into the professional world.
xp_eudeka_desc: During my internship at GITS Indonesia, I had the opportunity to contribute to their subsidiary Eudeka. The small team at Eudeka fostered a close-knit and fun-loving environment. Beyond coding, I gained valuable skills in teaching, creating educational content, and designing Instagram posts using Figma.
xp_blg_desc: This community has been an exciting part of my journey since high school days, stemming from casually writing reviews on Google Maps. This vibrant group allows us to explore new places around Bandung, help others through Google Maps contributions, and receive exclusive perks - all while being part of a passionate network with constant communication via a buzzing WhatsApp group.
